title: Desk bridge v0: market
description: The market for every kind (ADR 0107): list what the markets offer, install from them and remove what they installed. Every call needs plugin:manage.

MarketListRequest.description: List what the markets offer, every kind (ADR 0107).

MarketListResult.description: Result of market.list: every entry of every market in force, the first market that lists an id winning, and the markets that could not be read.

MarketListing.description: One entry as this desk sees it.

market.description: The index it came from, by URL.

verified.description: It comes from the endue index. Code plugins install only when it does; anything else is shown as not verified (signatures later, ADR 0005).

installed.description: The installed version, when there is one.

added.description: The permissions it asks that the installed version was not given: all of them for a new install. Shown before installing; plugin.install needs them accepted.

MarketState.description: available: not installed; installed: this version is; update: an older version is.

MarketProblem.description: A market that could not be read.

PluginInstallRequest.description: Install or update a plugin from a market (ADR 0107).

PluginInstallParams.description: Parameters of plugin.install: the entry by id (in the first market that lists it, or in market), and the permissions the person accepted, which must hold every permission the entry asks.

market.description: The index to take it from, by URL; the first that lists it when absent.

accept.description: The permissions the person accepted; the plugin is granted them.

PluginInstallResult.description: Result of plugin.install: the plugin as installed.

PluginRemoveRequest.description: Remove a plugin a market installed: its folder, its grants and its lock line.
